title: No committed E2E scenario for the reference-checks panel — the mandated bug-hunt acceptance depends on a scenario file absent at this sha
evidence: Briefing: "Re-run with `/bug-hunt reference_checks taken-over-reminder-hint` — expected PASS (the scenario yaml lives at `.pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/reference_checks/taken-over-reminder-hint.yaml` in the repo — locate the run path and follow the bug-hunt suite instructions; the verification-rerun precedent re-created the suite from the scenario specs)." Worktree `find .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios -type d` returned only: analytics, applications, auth, billing, comparison, dashboard, errors, landing, notifications, settings, ui, vacancies, workflows — no reference_checks; `find .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios -name "*reference*" -o -name "*reminder*"` returned nothing.
detail: Fix is verified only by unit tests in-repo; the E2E acceptance (briefing criterion 2) relies on runtime re-creation of a scenario that is not versioned, so CI/regression runs cannot re-verify it.
recommended_fix: Commit .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/reference_checks/taken-over-reminder-hint.yaml alongside the fix so `/bug-hunt reference_checks` is reproducible from the repo.

title: New test's doc claim "the timeline itself still renders" is unasserted — a fix that gutted the attempt log would still pass
evidence: Test doc: "The timeline itself still renders (the invite + takeover events stay visible); only the future-promise hint is dropped." Assertions actually present: "// The takeover surface renders… html |> string.contains("refcheck-taken-over-landlord_ref") |> should.be_true  html |> string.contains("You're handling this one") |> should.be_true  // …and the reminder promise is gone. html |> string.contains("Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply") |> should.be_false" — the taken-over pill (reference_panel.gleam:355) renders outside view_attempt_log, so deleting the whole attempt-log block would leave all three assertions green.
detail: The hint is inside view_attempt_log; removing the entire block kills both hint and timeline while keeping the pill, so the test cannot detect over-correction despite the comment promising the timeline survives.
recommended_fix: Add presence assertions for the timeline lines in the taken-over scenario, e.g. string.contains("Invitation sent") and string.contains(copy.refcheck_timeline_taken_over) |> should.be_true.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: Changed case expression: "let has_next_reminder = case call.status, taken_over(call) { ContactInitiated, False -> list.length(send_batches(call.attempt_log)) < 4; _, _ -> False }". Both arms pinned: new test taken_over_row_hides_next_reminder_hint_test asserts the hint is absent for a taken-over ContactInitiated row with 1 send batch (old code computed 1 < 4 → True, so the test fails on the pre-fix code), and existing invitation_sent_state_test asserts "string.contains("Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply") |> should.be_true" on a non-taken-over row (row() sets taken_over_at: None).
detail: Changed-behaviour coverage 100%: taken-over arm (new, regression-valid) and non-taken-over arm (existing invitation_sent_state_test) both pinned at unit level; no API/DB/auth surfaces touched. P0 100%, P1 >=90%, overall >=80% → PASS; only P3 notes (unasserted timeline claim, uncommitted E2E scenario).
recommended_fix: Raise to a clean PASS with zero caveats by asserting the attempt-log timeline lines in the new test and committing the taken-over-reminder-hint bug-hunt scenario.
